components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Archive Ink background shifts to Forge Amber on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #FAFAF8; background: #1C1917; border: 2px solid #1C1917; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B45309; border-color: #B45309; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B45309; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-arrow { transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with Archive Ink border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 14px 24px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #1C1917; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #1C1917; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #B45309; color: #B45309; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B45309; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: CTA Button (Forge Amber)
components.description: Amber CTA for download and calendar actions. Amber glow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; background: #B45309; border: none; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(180,83,9,0.2); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1), box-shadow 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(180,83,9,0.3); } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B45309; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stack Chip Tag
components.description: Tech stack tags on project rows. Shift to amber tint on parent hover.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #A8A29E; background: #F3F0EA; border: 1px solid #E8E3DB; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-project-row:hover .ds-chip { background: rgba(180,83,9,0.08); border-color: rgba(180,83,9,0.2); color: #B45309; }

components.name: Info Pill
components.description: Hero metadata labels. Static, no hover. Reads as a filing tag.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #78716C; background: #F3F0EA; border: 1px solid #E8E3DB; border-radius: 100px; padding: 8px 16px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Project Link
components.description: Bordered amber link paired with each project entry.
components.css: .ds-project-link { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #B45309; border: 1px solid rgba(180,83,9,0.2); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1); display: inline-block; } .ds-project-link:hover { background: rgba(180,83,9,0.08); border-color: #B45309; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-project-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B45309; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Mono uppercase kicker above every section heading. Forge Amber. Sparse.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #B45309; display: block; margin-bottom: 14px; }

narrative.overview:
A portfolio that reads like a notebook left open on a desk: precise annotations in the margins, amber highlights on the lines that matter, warm paper underneath everything. The system rewards close reading. Every element has a reason to be there; decoration is not a reason. The human dimension comes from the writing and the story, not from the chrome.

This is a system for someone who writes pure-PyTorch autograd engines from scratch and also founded a free AI research organisation in Sudan. That combination, rigorous and generous, technical and personal, is the throughline. The typography asserts authority; the amber accent signals warmth. Neither dominates.

What this system explicitly rejects: the dark dev portfolio template (black background, neon green or purple, terminal rain, floating code snippets), the generic SaaS landing page (gradient text, hero-metric stat blocks, AI-generated copy feel), and the overdesigned creative agency site (scroll-jacking, WebGL heroes, motion for motion's sake).
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment surfaces, not clinical white
Forge Amber used sparingly: headings, accents, interactive highlights only
Spectral italic for the signature moment; Figtree carries the argument
JetBrains Mono for all metadata, labels, and technical tags
Flat by default; depth through tonal layering, not shadows
Motion is purposeful and exits smoothly; no bounce, no overshooting

rules.name: The Forge Rule
rules.body: Forge Amber appears on ≤10% of any screen. Every additional use dilutes the signal. When in doubt, use Archive Ink or Ink Body instead.

rules.name: The Warmth Rule
rules.body: No pure black (#000), no pure white (#FFF). Every neutral is tinted toward the amber hue. If a neutral reads as cool or clinical on the warm parchment background, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Spectral Signature Rule
rules.body: Spectral italic appears in exactly two places: the hero last name and the italic story paragraphs. It does not appear in headings, body copy, or UI labels.

rules.name: The Mono as Metadata Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono signals technical metadata, never emphasis. If text needs emphasis, use Spectral or weight. Mono is not a substitute for visual hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface elevation can be expressed through background colour (Warm Ash Paper vs Old Page), it must be. Shadows are reserved for portrait photography, hover confirmation, and the amber CTA.

dos: Do use Forge Amber on ≤10% of any screen. Rarity is the signal.
Do tint every neutral toward the amber hue. No cool neutrals.
Do use Spectral italic exclusively for the hero last name and italic story paragraphs.
Do cap body text line length at 65ch on unconstrained layouts.
Do use tonal layering (Warm Ash Paper → Old Page) before reaching for shadows.
Do honour the Arabic RTL context: Cairo font, dir=rtl, direction-aware spacing.
Do ease out with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Nothing overshoots.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion. All animation durations collapse to 0.01ms.
donts: Don't use a side-stripe border (border-left or border-right > 1px as a coloured accent). Use a background tint and border-radius instead.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Emphasis through weight or Forge Amber solid colour.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Backdrop-filter permitted only on the scrolled nav bar.
Don't build a hero-metric template: big number, small label, gradient accent.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. No cubic-bezier with overshoot. No spring animations.
Don't add floating particles, animated code rain, or atmospheric particle effects.
Don't make the site look like a SaaS landing page: no feature grids with identical icon+heading+text cards.
Don't use Inter, Playfair Display, Fraunces, Cormorant, DM Sans, or Space Grotesk.
Don't use font-weight: 900. Spectral's maximum is 800.
Don't animate width, height, padding, or margin directly. Use transform or grid-template-rows.
